edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a protective direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.mechanism: If breastfeeding duration matters, the mechanism is likely cumulative early-life metabolic programming rather than a drug-like effect of one nutrient.
edges.summary: The strongest piece here is the 2025 Muscogiuri meta analysis in Nutrition, which ties breastfeeding for at least 12 months to adult obesity in a direction that later studies largely support. That makes this edge more about calibrating magnitude and context than arguing over whether the signal exists at all.
edges.caveats: Healthier-user bias, screening intensity, and baseline risk can all inflate apparent benefit in observational work, so the magnitude should be read conservatively.
